# Aging proteomics repository

> Search and quantification results for 25 public proteomics datasets, reanalysed with one pipeline into one schema, for questions about how organelle proteomes change with age. Every number here comes from catalog `b89fd37e4e4ee174` (datarepo 0.18.1, schema 0.0.9, built 2026-09-24T23:05:52+00:00); cite that id with any number you reuse.

Before you answer from this data:

- Counts at 1% FDR come from the `*_1pct` views (`psms_1pct`, `peptidoforms_1pct`, `protein_groups_1pct`). The base tables also hold decoys and sub-threshold matches.
- Each dataset page lists its open findings. A `low_id_rate` or `sdrf_skeleton` finding means the absence of a protein, or of sample metadata, is weak evidence.
- An empty table means nothing was delivered. It does not mean the answer is zero or none. The MCP `describe` tool says which tables are empty.
- Contaminant proteins (e.g. bovine albumin, porcine trypsin) are flagged and carry their own species. They are reagents, not evidence about the sample's organism.
- A protein group's accession list is kept in the search engine's order, and MetaMorpheus writes it alphabetically. The first accession is not a leading or razor protein, and nothing in this repository names one.

## Datasets

- [PXD010115: Quantification of the Soluble Receptor of Advanced Glycation End-Products (sRAGE) by LC-MS Without the Use of Affinity Enrichment](datasets/PXD010115.html): PXD010115 is a DDA label-free dataset (Homo sapiens) with 12 runs, 12 samples and no enrichment step (whole proteome). It was reanalysed with MetaMorpheus 1.1.11. At 1% FDR the search reports 118,418 PSMs, 10,287 peptidoforms and 436 protein groups, and the repository holds 7,593 PTM sites for it. 7 open warnings about it are recorded.
- [PXD011314: Profiling of Methylglyoxal Blood Metabolism and Advanced Glycation End-Product Proteome using a Chemical Probe](datasets/PXD011314.html): PXD011314 is a DDA label-free dataset (Homo sapiens) with 17 runs, 17 samples and an enrichment step outside the controlled list (recorded as `other`). It was reanalysed with MetaMorpheus 1.1.11. At 1% FDR the search reports 3,994 PSMs, 497 peptidoforms and 54 protein groups, and the repository holds 343 PTM sites for it. 6 open warnings about it are recorded.
- [PXD018315: Identification of proteins that interact with the lncRNA Sarrah](datasets/PXD018315.html): PXD018315 is a DDA label-free dataset (Mus musculus) with 40 runs, 40 samples and an enrichment step outside the controlled list (recorded as `other`). It was reanalysed with MetaMorpheus 1.1.11. ## Access

- [datasets.json](datasets.json): every fact on these pages, as JSON.
- [MCP server](https://github.com/trishorts/dataRepo/blob/master/docs/mcp.md): `datarepo mcp --catalog <catalog.duckdb>` serves a catalog to an agent over stdio (describe, search, read-only SQL).
- [Schema](https://github.com/trishorts/dataRepo/tree/master/docs/schema): every table and column, with its meaning.
- Bulk Parquet download: not published yet.

## Optional

- [Source code](https://github.com/trishorts/dataRepo): the ingester and catalog builder that made this data.
- [Limitations](https://github.com/trishorts/dataRepo/blob/master/docs/limitations.md): what the repository does not yet hold.
